translations.text: O man who strikes the bell at its hour, great is the [?] that it strikes for everyone. Hosts are listening to it; you are to be pitied if you grow weary of it.
Sweet to Christ is the voice of the bell in every graveyard outside where it is. It brings comfort to the souls of the wretched; great is its reward with the King.
All the hosts yonder are joyful when it is struck slowly and without deceit; they are displeased if it is struck quickly, whether for man, boy or woman.
The demon leaps away at the pure voice until he goes northward into the sea. No soul will be in torment, I say, for as long as it hears.
Strike the bell for God, slowly and gently, so that the land may know the reason for it, and so that you may receive God's blessing. Strike [?] with my left hand, O man! A[?].
